notes.title: Craft Your Own Story: Mystery Editor & Workshop content now available
notes.content:
We are thrilled to let you know that two brand-new features for Whispers in the West—the Mystery Editor and Steam Workshop support are now live! 


The Mystery Editor

Have you ever wanted to create your own murder mystery? Now you can:


 Craft Your Own Story – Develop a one-day mini-mystery or an intricate three-day case.
 Test Your Script Instantly – Try out your custom script in-game via Steam and refine it as needed.
 Playtest with Friends – Gather your friends to playtest your mystery (and remember, friends always play for free!).
 Share with the Community – Once you're satisfied, upload your case to the Steam Workshop and share your creation with the wider community.


Accessing the Editor

The Whispers in the West Mystery Editor is accessed online through your web browser. Go to https://editor.whispersinthewest.infinite-y.com/ and get started. (You will need to own a copy of the game first, of course).

First Workshop Case

In case you missed our previous announcement. A whole new case, Two Bad Sisters, will be free for all as the first workshop case.

Written by Jon Ingold, the acclaimed writer behind Overboard! and A Highland Song, Two Bad Sisters is a curious mystery that will challenge even the sharpest detectives.

The elegant Miss Sara Estelle has arrived in Brimstone, seeking your help to recover a valuable possession left with the priest. But there’s a twist—the priest insists she has already retrieved it! Who’s lying? Who’s telling the truth? And who’s simply mistaken? It’s up to you to uncover the mystery.

notes.title: [Dev Diary] Why do we offer cases as DLCs?
notes.content:
A most-asked question about Whispers in the West is why we decided to offer the cases as DLCs instead of offering a one-off-purchase game. We totally get that this pricing is unconventional for Steam, and we truly accept all the criticism. 

Whispers in the West is more of an experiment than a commercial project. We are humbled by players’ preference to purchase all the cases at once - we truly didn’t expect this. 

So, we feel it's important to communicate our thought process, and we hope to deliver more value to our players in the future.

The team behind this little game

How the team behind Whispers in the West was formed is a story in itself.

In 2021, in an already competitive job market, the hiring freeze, as a result of the pandemic, made it challenging for graduates to get started in the games industry that year. So we formed Team Dissonant - almost all the team were recent graduates - and we wanted to make our own game.

Here came another challenge, we all work remotely and we had never met in person. Fortunately, we had games - we played many online multiplayer games together, as well as traditional murder mystery games over Discord. We loved murder mysteries and were surprised to find out there were very few options to play this type of games online, in particular, without the need for a game master (GM).

So we decided to take on this challenge - creating an online multiplayer murder mystery game that can be shared among friends and can be played without a GM.

This is not a typical "first quest" for a group of graduates - mostly for the challenges that come with multiplayer games, even experienced teams don't easily go down this path; not to mention the fact that there were so few multiplayer narrative games. 

The team did such an amazing job in making Whispers in the West a reality. And we are so grateful for the help we received along the way, namely, UK Games Fund and Wings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/0adfcb6faec9728bb7ee057752fe6aba1ebf19fa.jpg
The pricing of Whispers in the West

The core game of Whispers in the West is priced at $4.99, which includes all the content of the free demo plus an hour-long case, The Break-in. All the subsequent cases are offered as DLCs, each priced at $6.99 - however, you can get all the DLCs in a bundle at a massively discounted price, about $25 depending on where you are, which offers 6 - 8 hours of gameplay - and your friends can join the game completely for free - a much-loved feature. If you play a case with three more friends, after the bundle discount, the cost to each player is ($6.99 - 38% bundle discount) / 4 = $1.

We firmly believe games are better when shared with friends, that's why we make sure "Friends always play for free" in Whispers in the West. Whether it's the core game or the DLCs, as long as a case is owned by one of the players, other players can always join the room for free (using the demo). So, if there are two or more friends you like to play games with, the cost of each case for each person is no more than a cup of coffee.

A lesser-known Steam tip is that, the type of bundle of Whispers in the West is called "Complete The Set" - meaning that even if you own part of the content in the bundle, you will only pay for the content you haven't owned when you purchase the bundle. So, for example, if you have bought the core game and a DLC, and now you want to buy the full bundle, you will only be charged for the difference. You will never end up repaying for what you already bought.

Each case in Whispers in the West is an hour long - some players like this, some don't. We can probably talk about the inception of this game in more detail another day. In short, we purposely made the game short and digestible for players. Honestly, it would be much easier to write long dialogues (although there are already 17k words in each case on average because of the non-linear nature of the story). But we cannot expect friends who come to play a game together to spend hours and hours reading the lines. We want to offer quality time for players, by focusing on the deduction and debate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/d6b7e4f5a40560ab07379e16c6ad5dc76d84dc5c.jpg
So, why DLCs?

It's important to mention that, however uncommon it seems for Steam, it's quite a standard practice to offer murder mystery games on an episodic basis. Indeed, the average pricing for traditional murder mystery games is around $20 per case (if delivered electronically, physical copies are more expensive). And the typical length for a case is 2 - 3 hours.

One of the reasons is that, unlike for single-player games, players need to find time to organise game sessions for multiplayer games. This can be challenging for some of us who are only able to play games like this once or twice a year. So, we did not price the game in an attempt to hook or scam the players - quite the opposite - we don't want to force players to pay for the content they don't need.

Another idea we have for Whispers in the West is that, if the game turns out to be successful, we want to invite guest writers to create cases for the game. Offering each case as a separate DLC gives us the flexibility to do this kind of collaboration.



We genuinely welcome different opinions and we do understand why some players feel uncomfortable about the pricing. We will do our best to deliver more value to our players in the future. In fact, we are working on a custom case editor, so anyone can write their own mysteries, play with friends, upload the cases to Steam workshop and share with the wider community - this will be offered completely for free.
 
Last but not least, making independent games in today’s economic climate is not easy. Every comment you leave on Steam can potentially have an impact on the members of the team. Similarly, if you recognise our values, please do not hesitate to offer us some words of encouragement. Thank you.

notes.title: How to set up Twitch integration
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VJFoGRbynoU;full][/previewyoutube]

The Twitch integration enables your audience to interact with you in the game through the Twitch chat.


Your viewers can prompt you to ask about something or someone by typing in the chat command "!ask [a character or a letter]"
Your viewers can vote on the answers by using the chat command "!vote [a character or a letter]"



Get the OAuth code for your Twitch account

[olist]
Go to https://twitchapps.com/tmi/ in the browser where you are logged in with your Twitch account. 
Click "Connect".
On the next page, "Authorize" the Twitch Chat OAuth Token Generator app to read your channel's chat messages.
Then, you should see an OAuth token starting with "oauth".
Copy this token (including "oauth:").
[/olist]

* To remove the permission, go to Twitch settings.

Enter the OAuth code in Whispers in the West

[olist]
Launch Whispers in the West from Steam
On the case selection screen, click the gear icon on the top right.
Then go to "Steaming"
Enter the name of your Twitch channel, and the OAuth token you copied in the previous step.
Optionally, you can save your token in the game.
Slide the "Connect to Twitch" toggle to the right
Once you see "Connected", start a game and your audience will be able to interact with you 
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/50fdf0d1a6b94bcaee5e759ac93b6aa07d39aa58.png

notes.title: Launch Week Discount
notes.content:
For the launch week only, you can buy the all-six-case bundle at a 50% discount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/0d818bbfa3fd472c6ccefb69bffd75b762a2388d.png
The Break-in: The Break-in comes with the base game. Dawn breaks to find the Brimstone Bank broken open. What comes spilling out could bury this town. It's time to roll up your sleeves and get sleuthing, before everything unravels.

The Cult: A grizzly murder with an old-fashioned weapon! A town overrun with superstition and paranoia! An inventor and “saviour” who claims he can remake the world! Four investigators to make sense of it all before it's too late.

The Ghost: The Brimstone mine has swallowed a victim! Old resentments are rising from the dead. Only the truth can banish what is to come. Brimstone needs a team who aren't afraid of no ghost to bust this case.

The Giraffe: The circus is in town and passions are as high as a giraffe's head. Can the famously murder-happy residents of Brimstone enjoy the exotic delights of the circus without butchering one another in the dark?

The Cocktail: The who's who of Brimstone is throwing a party after an incredible windfall. The ice is cold, the drinks are exotic, and the odds of survival are... about the same.

The Curse: Something has been festering in the heart of Brimstone for years. Escalating events reveal a disturbing truth at the core of Brimstone. Will you be able to solve the mystery and bring the secrets to light?

Each case is designed to be solved in about 60 - 90 minutes - that’s 6 - 9 hours of gameplay guaranteed in the initial release. Although, if you are playing solo, it’s likely to take a little longer. 

Friends play for free

As promised, Whispers in the West is a point-and-click adventure with a twist - as a player, you can either go solo or collaborate with family or friends. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/839f5b48ce32cdad45d1d81847f2b2436a6f10de.jpg
Unlike many co-op games, Whispers in the West doesn’t require those who are invited to buy another copy of the game. Anyone can join a room using the Steam demo for free, as long as the host owns the game. Because we are a firm believer that games are better with friends, and friends should play for free.

Can’t find people to play with? Head to the gamer-pals channel on our Discord server and make new friends.

Twitch Integration for Streamers

Whispers in the West could not have existed without our previous Twitch streamers and their community. To support streamers better engaging with their audience, we designed a Twitch integration that enables viewers to interact with the streamer in the game through chat - viewers can prompt the streamers to check on a suspect or vote on the final answers. 
[previewyoutube=VJFoGRbynoU;full][/previewyoutube]

Multi-languages for the Base Game

For gamers from 🇲🇽 🇦🇷 🇪🇸 🇩🇪 🇨🇱 🇨🇴 🇯🇵 🇺🇾 🇻🇪 and beyond, we are glad to announce that the base game will be available in English, Spanish, German and Japanese. However, the DLCs are in English only at the moment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/e7381978b78a1e2ddc323f0460f5f8b23b8b68e7.png
Sorry, we’d really like to offer the full game to a global audience, but unfortunately, our budget doesn’t allow us to localise the full game or in more languages. That’s why, if you’d like to see more content in your language, please let the world know - that’s the only way we can do it.

Here are some ways you can help us

👯‍♀️ Enjoy the game with friends 
🐦 Tweet or retweet about us 
📺 Let your favourite streamers or YouTubers know about Whispers in the West - we are on Lurkit 
💬 Join our Discord server discord.gg/CRfhJXvGRS

Most importantly, ✍️ Give us a review on Steam - 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868070/

notes.title: Kickstarter: One Week Left
notes.content:
Thank you all for supporting Whispers in the West so far. Our Kickstarter campaign is now in its final stages, and all of the support has been greatly appreciated.

We are inching toward our final goal, but if you’d like to see the stories come to life, we still need your support - with just over a week left in the campaign, if you haven’t already checked out the Kickstarter page, now is the time. 


What is the campaign about?

With this Kickstarter campaign, we’re raising funds to create three new game scripts. If you’ve tried the demo, these new scripts will be in a similar format as the ghost story. Each of these stories will be an hour-long mystery, for up to 4 players to solve together.

Over the past year, we’ve been hard at work, and we were delighted to gain some start-up funding and recognition through the London Games Festival and UK Games Fund. But now, we need your support so we can continue the development of Whispers in the West. 

Pledges start from as little as £20 and, as long as the campaign is a success, you’ll get a bundle of the base game plus all three new game scripts - an equivalent to three mystery parties for up to 4 players - cheaper than buying each of them a drink :-) 


Kickstarter supporter merchandise

We’ve also hand-picked some unique merchandise for our early supporters: 

Pledge £35 or more, you will get the base game + 3 new mysteries + 5 special postcards ⬇️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/5aa27bdba8cde35e9723d5c1ba9a4d8ef8fa4168.png

Pledge £50 or more, you will get all of the above + a limited-edition jigsaw puzzle ⬇️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/b717aa797c82ab4b0e997bc7ed9d9d1ea974b3ee.jpg

Pledge £100 or more, you will get all of the above + a SILVER sheriff badge ⬇️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/f996de63a6270d7e2284e08efca35136d6a2ba0c.jpg

How else you can help us

With only a week left of the Kickstarter, support from the community is more appreciated now than ever, and even just spreading the word about the campaign would be greatly appreciated. A few ideas for how you can help us spread the word are:


 Tweeting or retweeting about the game
 Writing a review in the comments section of the Kickstarter campaign
 Introducing the game to your friends on other social media, such as Reddit, Facebook or Instagram
 If you know of a press, podcast, or influencer who might be of interest, let us know


Thank you all so much for your support up until now, and, whether you want to help or just stay in the know about the project’s progress, here are some links that you can use to get in touch with us:

Email: hello@infinite-y.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/rh8H9Wsgds

notes.title: Major update: Soundtracks, In-game Voice Chat and more
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of Whispers in the West. Since we released the demo during Steam Next Fest, more than 1500 players have tried it, and 1200 players have wishlisted the game on Steam so far.

We’re delighted by the positive feedback we received from many of you, and we’ve not sat back since the launch of the demo. After nearly two months of hard work, we’re delighted to  introduce a few exciting new features:

Soundtracks
This is music to our ears!! We’ve now included two beautifully composed tracks “Confronting the Man in Black” and “We Don’t Need Railroads” from Harvey Carmen(@composercarman ) in the game. Besides being a talented musician, Harvey has also been a long-time patron of Whispers in the West.

In-game Voice Chat
We’ve made it easier for you to communicate with your friends by incorporating voice chat in the game. Of course, you can still use your favourite voice chat software like Discord if you prefer. 

Improved Message Pinning feature
Now you can pin messages directly in the dialogues, and pinned messages will be broadcast to your party, making it easier to take notes and community with your teammates.

Enhanced Case Report UI
We have reworked the Case Report UI.

Game Flow Highlighting
We have made it simpler and easier to follow the flow of the game. 

Unity Analytics
To help us identify and analyse any technical issues, we introduced Unity Analytics. This means we can fix bugs more quickly, leaving you and your team to solve the case with no interruptions. You can opt in/out of this feature in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/80cb065f266a548a162005a7472a630e1eadd529.jpg

We’d like to present you with the best game experience possible, and we need your support! In case you missed it, we’re running a Kickstarter campaign to raise funds for three new mystery scripts. We’ve also hand-picked some unique merchandise for our early supporters. 

Make sure you check it out here: 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/whispersinthewest/whispers-in-the-west

notes.title: Whispers In The West Hotfix - V7.0.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41825657/b7cba90d89763a90215180d3674ac777f9d2c10f.jpg

We would like to thank everyone who has tried the demo for Whispers In The West for their support.

We have published a patch for the demo to address some issues we discovered during the Steam Next Fest. You can find the patch notes below.

UI
Fixed player icons covering the main street name on the map.
Links for the discord, website and twitter on the main menu are now clickable.

Cinematic
Adjusted scaling on certain aspects of the outro cinematic for the ghost script.

Networking
Added an error popup when you are disconnected from the Photon Network. 
When you are disconnected from the Photon Network, you will be automatically returned to the main menu where the game will try to reconnect automatically.

Fixes
Portrait no longer disappears in the ghost script.
Various UI positioning fixes.
As a result of fixing disconnections from the photon network, players should no longer run into an issue where their character vanishes and becomes zoomed in.
